description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce - Notifying that authorized the purpose for which the Society known as "Colombo Port Club" as a purpose to which the powers & facilities of the Societies Ordinance ought to be extended
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal framework) to authorize a society's purpose and grant a legal exemption from specific provisions of that Ordinance. It deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
